title: Enact agent definition
description: One version of an agent, packaged from its directory: the manifest from agent.json, the text of every other file and its binary files (assets) by SHA-256. docs/agent-contract.md describes each field.

version.description: Semantic version without build metadata. Immutable once saved.

repository.description: A GitHub repository as owner/name, in lowercase. The name cannot be . or .., which GitHub forbids.

secret_name.description: An environment variable name for a secret. Names starting AWS_, ANTHROPIC_, CLAUDE_, ENACT_, GIT_, LD_ or NODE_, and PATH, HOME, SHELL, USER, TMPDIR, IS_SANDBOX, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER, BASH_ENV and ENV, are the sandbox's own and refused.

library_skill.description: A skill library version the agent uses: PUT /skills/{name} saved it.

model.description: The model family; the run chooses the credential and the concrete model.

channels.description: Entrances that may start a run: direct (the API and the MCP endpoint) and asana.

run_repositories.description: Lets each run name up to max more repositories, each on the environment's allowed list, all with these permissions. Without it a run names none.

create_repositories.description: Lets the agent create up to max repositories per session from these template repositories with the create_repository tool, each under its template's owner; the session then uses each with these permissions. The templates must be allowed like repositories, and every turn may read them. Needs the environment's app_installations on and the App's Repository creation permission (docs/repositories.md).

tools.description: Built-in tools the sandbox gives the agent beyond Claude Code's own: browser (a Chromium in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser through Playwright's MCP tools) and figma (read-only Figma tools as the person who started the run, when they saved their own Figma token with PUT /connections/figma; without one the run goes on without them).

browser.description: How the browser tool behaves; needs browser in tools. sandbox_localhost: true makes http(s)://localhost:<port>/ and 127.0.0.1 in the browser the sandbox's own loopback, so the agent can open an app it runs in its sandbox.

asana.description: Gives the agent the asana tools, which call Asana as Enact's bot user. They reach only these projects, their tasks and those tasks' subtasks.

manage_projects.description: true adds asana_add_task_to_project, asana_get_project and asana_add_project_members, on these projects only.

secrets.description: Secrets the agent needs, by environment variable name. An operator sets each value per agent (PUT /agents/{name}/secrets/{secret}); every turn gets the values as environment variables, and a run whose secret is not set fails before its turn (SECRET_ERROR). Values are never part of the definition.

library_skills.description: Skills from the environment's skill library, each by name and pinned version. The sandbox lays each out at skills/<name>/ beside the agent's own skills; the agent may not also hold files under skills/<name>/. Each must be in the library when the agent is saved.

mcp_servers.description: Remote MCP servers the agent uses, by name, each on the environment's allowed list (GET /mcp-servers). Every turn registers them as Streamable HTTP MCP servers; their hosts are added to hosts for egress.

hosts.description: Hosts a run may connect to, beyond what every run needs.

files.description: Every file of the agent directory except agent.json, by path, as UTF-8 text.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.

assets.description: Binary files of the agent's skills (images, fonts, PDFs) by path under skills/<name>/, each by its SHA-256 and size. Upload the bytes with POST /agents/{name}/assets before saving; the sandbox lays them out beside the files. At most 32 MiB each and 128 MiB together.
